en.home.tagline: A little movement. A new morning.
en.statistics.note: Each day uses the first scheduled alarm. Completion time is when the task ends, not a measurement of leaving bed. Days without an alarm are excluded. No completion record does not prove an alarm sounded.
en.history.clearConfirm: Clear completed records? Active tasks and restrictions are kept.
en.reset.confirm: Cancel alarms, remove Okiru restrictions, and erase your alarm history?
en.alarm.name: Alarm name
en.alarm.first: Tap + to plan your first morning.
en.alarm.deleteConfirm: Delete this alarm? Existing active restrictions still require completion or emergency release.
en.task.title: Wake-up challenge
en.challenge.late: Past the five-minute goal — you can still finish
en.challenge.leaveNote: Leaving this screen does not complete the task or release restrictions.
en.practice.note: Practice only. No alarm record or restriction is changed.
en.result.onTime: 10 completed. You met your five-minute goal!
en.result.late: Task completed. Recorded as late; time-based restrictions may still apply.
en.result.emergency: Current challenges released. Future alarms remain scheduled.
en.camera.guide: Place your phone securely, use the front camera from a side angle, and keep your whole body in view. Move down and back up for one repetition.
en.camera.tracking: Body detected. Complete each down-and-up movement.
en.camera.interrupted: Camera interrupted. Return to Okiru to continue.
en.reminders.title: Wake-up reminders
en.reminders.description: Dismissing one alert does not complete your task. Background follow-ups target three-second spacing using a limited pre-scheduled queue, up to three hours after the original alarm; exact delivery and coverage depend on iOS and available capacity. They do not bypass silent mode or Focus.
en.reminders.limited: Capacity is limited. The count and last time above show actual scheduled coverage. Primary alarms are kept first. Open Okiru to refresh follow-up coverage.
en.notification.body: Your 10 push-ups are waiting. Dismissing this notification does not complete the task.
en.restriction.title: App restrictions
en.restriction.unlockRule: After the linked challenge, restrictions lift following your selected delay. iOS may apply the release later; overlapping restrictions remain effective. You can revoke access in Settings.
en.restriction.appsOnly: Choose individual allowed apps only (up to 50), such as Spotify.
en.shield.message: Open Okiru to complete your wake-up challenge. Restrictions lift after completion and the selected delay; emergency release is available in Okiru.
en.emergency.title: Release current restrictions?
en.emergency.message: This clears currently active Okiru restrictions and wake-up prompts. It is not a successful challenge. Future schedules are kept.
en.permission.camera.description: Okiru uses the front camera to count push-ups on this device. No video is stored or uploaded.
en.permission.alarm.description: Okiru schedules the wake-up alarms you create.
en.onboarding.title: Wake up with 10 push-ups.
en.onboarding.task: Finish within five minutes of your first daily alarm to meet your goal.
en.onboarding.reminders: Dismissing an alert does not complete your challenge.
en.onboarding.privacy: Camera processing stays on your phone. No video is saved or uploaded.
en.onboarding.emergency: Feeling unwell, a camera problem, or an urgent situation? Hold emergency release for three seconds and confirm. This is recorded separately from success.
en.mode.modern: System alarm mode (iOS 26+). Follow-up notifications still depend on notification and Focus settings.
en.mode.legacy: Notification reminder mode (iOS 17/18). Sound is affected by silent mode, Focus and notification settings; continuous ringing is not guaranteed.
en.compatibility.description: iOS 17/18 uses local notifications for primary alarms. These do not guarantee sound through silent mode or Focus. iOS 26 and later uses AlarmKit for primary alarms; authorized alarms can break through silent mode and Focus, but iOS still provides a stop control. All versions use limited local notifications for follow-ups. They do not inherit AlarmKit's stronger delivery. Camera challenges run only while Okiru is open. Screen Time requires permission and can be revoked. Never assume a five-second background loop or an unbreakable device lock. Actual follow-up count and end time are shown in Alarm.
en.feedback.privacy: Sending includes this form, optional email, app version, system version and display language. No camera images or alarm history are attached. Failed submissions keep the draft on your device.
en.feedback.unconfigured: The feedback service is not deployed yet. Your draft stays on this device.
en.feedback.invalid: Enter a summary and details within the length limits.
en.feedback.failed: The server did not confirm receipt. Your draft is kept; try again.
en.review.unavailable: Reviews will be available when Okiru has a public App Store listing.
en.privacy.body: Okiru works without an account, advertising or tracking. Alarm settings, task counts and history stay on this device. The front camera is processed locally to detect body joints; Okiru does not save or upload video. Screen Time app selections are handled using Apple's privacy-preserving tokens. If you choose to send feedback, its text, optional email and app/system/language details are sent to the developer's dedicated Google Apps Script and Google Sheet. No camera frames or alarm history are included. You can clear completed history or reset Okiru in Settings. Removing permissions prevents the related feature from operating. This development build still requires production support and privacy URLs before release.
en.test.scheduled: Test notification scheduled. Keep Okiru open and wait five seconds.
en.test.note: This tests notification delivery, not AlarmKit lock-screen reliability. Real overnight device tests are required.
en.error.appgroup: Shared storage is unavailable. A signed device build needs the registered Okiru App Group.
en.error.storage: Could not read or save local data. Changes were not confirmed.
en.error.restrictionPermission: Screen Time access is unavailable or revoked. Restrictions cannot be confirmed.
en.error.restrictionDuration: A restriction window must be at least 15 minutes and less than 24 hours.
en.error.alarmPermission: Allow system alarms in Settings before enabling this alarm.
en.error.notificationPermission: Notifications are not allowed. Follow-up alerts cannot be scheduled; check Settings.
en.error.capacity: There is not enough notification capacity for these primary alarms. Reduce active schedules.
en.error.scheduleVerification: The system did not retain all requested alerts. This schedule is not confirmed.
en.error.invalidAlarm: The alarm time or weekdays are invalid.
en.error.pastDate: Choose a future date for a one-time alarm.
en.error.recovery: Schedule recovery needs attention. Check permissions and reopen Okiru before relying on alarms.
en.error.cameraPermission: Allow camera access in Settings to count push-ups.
en.error.cameraUnavailable: The front camera is unavailable. Use a real iPhone or emergency release.
en.error.sound: The selected alarm sound could not be loaded.
en.error.alarmLimit: The system alarm limit was reached. Okiru removed stale schedules; try saving again.
en.restriction.scopeNote: Select Safari here to shield it directly. iOS may leave some system apps available; website categories are shielded on a best-effort basis.
en.notification.body.target: Complete %d push-ups in Okiru. Dismissing this alert does not complete the task.
en.practice.ephemeral: These measurements stay only in memory until exported. No images or video are included.
en.practice.exportCancelled: Export was cancelled; the measurements are still here.
en.result.late.dynamic: Challenge completed late. Restrictions remain until the selected delay ends.
en.challenge.late.target: More than %d minutes have passed; you can still complete the task.
en.restriction.unlockRule.dynamic: Restrictions lift after challenge completion plus the selected delay. iOS may apply it later; overlapping restrictions remain effective.
en.shield.message.dynamic: Open Okiru to finish the challenge. Restriction release follows completion plus your selected delay; emergency release is available.
en.onboarding.task.dynamic: Choose 5–100 push-ups per alarm. Finish within five minutes for 5–45 reps, or ten minutes for 50–100 reps.
en.restriction.blockedOnly: Choose individual apps and websites to block (up to 50 each), not entire categories.
en.error.notificationAlerts: Turn on Banners for Okiru in iPhone Settings > Notifications, then try again.
en.permission.setup.intro: Allow these permissions so alarms and push-up counting work as expected. Screen Time is optional unless you use app restrictions.
en.error.notificationSounds: Turn on Sounds for Okiru in iPhone Settings > Notifications. After a system alarm is stopped, iOS will not let follow-up notifications force sound through Silent Mode.

zh-Hant.home.empty: 從這裡開始你的下一個早晨。
zh-Hant.statistics.note: 每天以第一個有效鬧鐘計算。完成時間是任務結束時間，不代表實際離床時間。沒設鬧鐘的日子不計入；缺少完成紀錄也不能證明鬧鐘曾成功響起。
zh-Hant.history.clearConfirm: 清除已結束的紀錄？進行中的任務與限制仍會保留。
zh-Hant.reset.confirm: 取消鬧鐘、解除 Okiru 限制，並清除鬧鐘紀錄？
zh-Hant.alarm.name: 鬧鐘名稱
zh-Hant.alarm.first: 按右上角＋，規劃第一個早晨。
zh-Hant.alarm.deleteConfirm: 刪除此鬧鐘？已生效的限制仍須完成任務或緊急解除。
zh-Hant.task.title: 起床挑戰
zh-Hant.challenge.late: 已超過五分鐘，仍可完成任務
zh-Hant.challenge.leaveNote: 離開此畫面不會完成任務，也不會解除限制。
zh-Hant.practice.note: 這是練習，不影響鬧鐘紀錄或使用限制。
zh-Hant.result.onTime: 完成十下，達成五分鐘目標！
zh-Hant.result.late: 任務完成，記為逾時；尚未到結束時間的限制仍保留。
zh-Hant.result.emergency: 已解除目前挑戰，未來鬧鐘排程保留。
zh-Hant.camera.guide: 將手機穩固放好，以前鏡頭從側前方拍到全身。完整下壓再撐起，才會計一次。
zh-Hant.camera.tracking: 已辨識身體，請完整下壓再撐起。
zh-Hant.camera.interrupted: 相機暫時中斷，返回 Okiru 後繼續。
zh-Hant.reminders.title: 再次提醒
zh-Hant.reminders.description: 滑掉一次提醒不代表完成任務。背景以有限佇列預排每三秒一則的追加通知，最晚不超過首次鬧鐘後三小時；實際送達時間與覆蓋受 iOS 和可用容量限制。追加通知不能穿透靜音或專注設定。
zh-Hant.reminders.limited: 排程容量有限，上方顯示實際次數與最後提醒時間。主鬧鐘優先保留；開啟 Okiru 會更新追加提醒覆蓋。
zh-Hant.notification.body: 還有十下伏地挺身等你完成。滑掉此通知不代表完成任務。
zh-Hant.restriction.title: App 使用限制
zh-Hant.restriction.unlockRule: 完成對應任務後，再經過所選延遲時間才解除；iOS 可能較晚執行。重疊限制仍各自有效，也可在系統設定撤銷授權。
zh-Hant.restriction.appsOnly: 請只選個別允許的 App，最多五十個，例如 Spotify。
zh-Hant.shield.message: 請開啟 Okiru 完成起床挑戰。完成任務並經過所選延遲時間後解除限制；也可在 Okiru 使用緊急解除。
zh-Hant.emergency.title: 解除目前限制？
zh-Hant.emergency.message: 這會清除目前生效的 Okiru 限制與催醒，不算挑戰成功，未來排程保留。
zh-Hant.permission.camera.description: Okiru 使用前鏡頭在此裝置辨識伏地挺身次數，不儲存或上傳影片。
zh-Hant.permission.alarm.description: Okiru 會排定你建立的起床鬧鐘。
zh-Hant.onboarding.title: 做十下，迎接早晨。
zh-Hant.onboarding.task: 當天第一個鬧鐘響鈴後，五分鐘內完成任務即可達標。
zh-Hant.onboarding.reminders: 滑掉提醒不代表完成挑戰。
zh-Hant.onboarding.privacy: 鏡頭影像只在手機辨識，不儲存或上傳影片。
zh-Hant.onboarding.emergency: 身體不適、相機故障或有急事時，長按緊急解除三秒並確認，會另外記錄，不算挑戰成功。
zh-Hant.mode.modern: 系統鬧鐘模式（iOS 26+）。追加提醒仍受通知與專注設定影響。
zh-Hant.mode.legacy: 通知提醒模式（iOS 17／18）。靜音、專注與通知設定會影響聲音，不保證持續響鈴。
zh-Hant.compatibility.description: iOS 17／18 的主鬧鐘採本機通知，不保證穿透靜音與專注。iOS 26 以上使用 AlarmKit，授權後的主鬧鐘可穿透靜音與專注，但系統仍提供停止操作。所有版本的追加提醒都是有限預排通知，不繼承 AlarmKit 的完整能力。自拍任務只在 Okiru 開啟時執行。App 限制需要螢幕使用時間授權，且可被撤銷。不能保證背景每五秒提醒或完全不可繞過的鎖定；鬧鐘頁會顯示實際追加提醒次數與最後時間。
zh-Hant.feedback.privacy: 送出時包含此表單、選填 Email、App 版本、系統版本及介面語言，不會附上鏡頭影像或鬧鐘歷史。送出失敗時，草稿保留在此裝置。
zh-Hant.feedback.unconfigured: 回饋服務尚未部署，草稿會保留在此裝置。
zh-Hant.feedback.invalid: 請填寫摘要與詳情，且不超過字數限制。
zh-Hant.feedback.cooldown: 兩次回饋送出請間隔二十秒。
zh-Hant.feedback.failed: 伺服器未確認收到，草稿仍保留，請再試一次。
zh-Hant.review.unavailable: Okiru 正式上架 App Store 後即可留下評論。
zh-Hant.privacy.body: Okiru 不需要帳號，不含廣告或追蹤。鬧鐘設定、任務次數及歷史紀錄保存在此裝置。前鏡頭只在裝置端辨識人體關節，不儲存或上傳影片。App 選取使用 Apple 提供的不透明識別碼處理。若你主動送出回饋，表單文字、選填 Email、App／系統版本及語言會傳送到開發者專屬的 Google Apps Script 與 Google Sheets，不含鏡頭畫面或鬧鐘歷史。你可在設定清除已結束紀錄，或重設 Okiru。撤銷權限後，對應功能將無法運作。本開發版本仍須在上架前配置正式支援與隱私網址。
zh-Hant.test.scheduled: 已排定測試通知，請保持 Okiru 開啟並等待五秒。
zh-Hant.test.note: 此測試只驗證通知，不代表 AlarmKit 鎖屏可靠性；仍須真機跨夜測試。
zh-Hant.error.appgroup: 共享儲存空間不可用。真機簽署版本需配置已註冊的 Okiru App Group。
zh-Hant.error.storage: 無法讀取或儲存本機資料，變更尚未確認。
zh-Hant.error.restrictionPermission: 螢幕使用時間權限不可用或已撤銷，無法確認限制已生效。
zh-Hant.error.restrictionDuration: 限制時段須至少十五分鐘，且短於二十四小時。
zh-Hant.error.alarmPermission: 啟用此鬧鐘前，請先在系統設定允許鬧鐘。
zh-Hant.error.notificationPermission: 尚未允許通知，無法排定追加提醒，請檢查系統設定。
zh-Hant.error.capacity: 通知容量不足以容納這些主鬧鐘，請減少啟用中的排程。
zh-Hant.error.scheduleVerification: 系統未保留所有要求的提醒，此排程尚未確認。
zh-Hant.error.invalidAlarm: 鬧鐘時間或星期設定無效。
zh-Hant.error.pastDate: 單次鬧鐘請選擇未來的日期與時間。
zh-Hant.error.recovery: 排程恢復需要處理，請檢查權限並重新開啟 Okiru，再依賴鬧鐘。
zh-Hant.error.cameraPermission: 請在系統設定允許相機，以辨識伏地挺身。
zh-Hant.error.cameraUnavailable: 前鏡頭不可用，請使用實體 iPhone 或緊急解除。
zh-Hant.error.alarmLimit: 已達系統鬧鐘數量上限。Okiru 已清理舊排程，請再儲存一次。
zh-Hant.restriction.scopeNote: 可在此明確選取 Safari 直接遮罩。部分系統 App 可能無法封鎖；網站類別採 iOS 可提供的範圍。
zh-Hant.restriction.afterCompletion: 任務完成後＋所選延遲時間
zh-Hant.notification.body.target: 請在 Okiru 完成 %d 下伏地挺身。滑掉通知不代表完成任務。
zh-Hant.practice.ephemeral: 數值只暫存在記憶體，除非主動匯出；不含影像或影片。
zh-Hant.practice.exportCancelled: 已取消匯出，數值仍保留在此畫面。
zh-Hant.diagnostic.stale: 追蹤中斷：舊數值已隱藏
zh-Hant.result.onTime.target: 完成 %d 下伏地挺身，達成 %d 分鐘目標！
zh-Hant.result.late.dynamic: 任務已逾時完成；限制會在所選延遲時間結束後解除。
zh-Hant.challenge.late.target: 已超過 %d 分鐘，仍可完成任務。
zh-Hant.restriction.unlockRule.dynamic: 完成任務並經過所選延遲時間後解除限制；iOS 可能較晚執行，重疊限制各自有效。
zh-Hant.shield.message.dynamic: 請開啟 Okiru 完成挑戰；完成後經過所選延遲時間即可解除限制，也可使用緊急解除。
zh-Hant.onboarding.task.dynamic: 每個鬧鐘可設定 5–100 下。5–45 下五分鐘內完成、50–100 下十分鐘內完成即可達標。
zh-Hant.restriction.blockedOnly: 請只選個別要封鎖的 App 與網站，各最多五十個，不接受整個分類。
zh-Hant.error.notificationAlerts: 請在 iPhone「設定」>「通知」>「Okiru」開啟橫幅後再試一次。
zh-Hant.permission.setup.intro: 請允許以下權限，讓鬧鐘與伏地挺身計次正常運作。只有使用 App 限制時才需要螢幕使用時間權限。
zh-Hant.error.notificationSounds: 請在 iPhone「設定」>「通知」>「Okiru」開啟「聲音」。系統鬧鐘被停止後，iOS 不允許追加通知強制穿透靜音模式。
